title: TSX Crystal with Integrated Thermistor
summary: CTS introduces the TSX crystal series with an integrated thermistor, providing real-time temperature feedback, excellent crystal thermal coupling, and compact SMD packages for active frequency compensation.
body_markdown:
### Telecommunications


Base stations and mobile devices requiring stable frequency performance.


### Consumer Electronics


Smartphones and wearable devices with compact design requirements.


### Automotive


Infotainment systems and electronic control units requiring reliable components.


### Industrial Instrumentation


Measurement and instrumentation systems that benefit from temperature feedback.


### Medical Devices


Compact electronics where stable frequency performance and reliability are important.


### Network Synchronization


Routers, switches, and network systems using precise timing references.
